state:
Goal `core-request-1-2`: `Core\Request::body` has all its feature proofs. A proof program can now
answer a request. A `<name>.nvsr` beside it (the `nvs run --request` file, `nvs_test::request`'s module
doc) is passed as `--request` by `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts`'s `spawnProof`, for examples, attacks and
benches alike (`docs/examples/README.md` § *A request for the program*). The `body` slice also fixed
`Core\Hash::of`/`hmac`/`equals`/`Stream::update`, which refused a `tainted` argument: they are now
`Qual::Neutral`, as the spec's column says, and the four rows are gone from `UNCLASSIFIED`.
`Core\Request` has its class card and is off `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.

next.title: member proofs, one file set
next.note: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs`, and `docs/examples/core/Request/`, `tests/hostile/core/Request/` and `benches/members/core/Request/`, each with `.nvsr` request files beside the programs:

items.text: **`Core\Request::bytes`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:305`. Its `MethodDoc` card is in the internal voice; rewrite it the way `BODY_DOC` now reads. `body`'s examples and `.nvsr` files are the pattern.

**`Core\Request::bodyStream`** — owes examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs:332`. The Rust tests near `a_body_stream_yields_the_chunks_the_wire_delivered` need only a `// covers:` marker. Rewrite its card too.

backlog: A `.nvsr` body that is not valid UTF-8 cannot be written with Write or Edit, so `body`'s `ParseError` path has no attack. `bytes` is where one belongs. Not checked: whether `bun nv splice` can write raw bytes.

`Core\Router::url`/`urlAbsolute` and `Core\Csv::parse`/`format` are still in `UNCLASSIFIED` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`). A proof that passes them a request value will hit the same refusal `Core\Hash` did.
